answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, honest service to retain influence; a burst of activity quickly fades. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because established, trusted peers have not supplied reciprocal endorsements, and reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits fabricated links from amplifying one another. Like an ember in a garden below a ridge, it cannot gain enough consensus weight without durable, independently validated trust.
